Specification: This module provides Apalache-oriented type annotations for an underlying prisoner-switch specification by declaring the constants and variables with comments describing their intended types, then instantiating the module `Prisoners`. The file itself does not define the algorithmic transition relation, temporal specification, or proof obligations; instead, it serves as a thin wrapper around the imported `Prisoners` module while introducing concrete constant values used by configuration. It models a system with a set of prisoners, a distinguished counter prisoner, two Boolean switches, a function recording how many times each prisoner has switched, and an integer count, but no fault model or temporal properties are stated directly in this file.
